faq.q: How much is a pay monthly website in the UK?
faq.a: Most UK pay monthly websites cost £49 to £199 a month with no upfront fee. Prices usually include design, hosting and updates.

faq.q: Are pay monthly websites worth it?
faq.a: They suit small businesses that want a professional site without a large upfront bill and want updates handled. Check ownership and minimum term first.

faq.q: Do I own a pay monthly website?
faq.a: It depends on the provider. Always ask whether the domain is in your name and what happens to the site and content if you cancel.

faq.q: What's the cheapest way to get a website in the UK?
faq.a: A DIY builder at about £3–£16 a month, if you have the time to build and maintain it yourself.

faq.q: Can I see the website before paying?
faq.a: Some providers offer previews. The ContentFellow Build Fellow includes a free homepage preview within 3 working days.
